import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = (int)1e9 + 7;
    static long n;
    static int k;
    static List<List<int[]>> pref = new ArrayList<>();

    static int sum(int a, int b) {
        int s = a + b;
        if (s >= mod) s -= mod;
        return s;
    }

    static int sub(int a, int b) {
        int s = a - b;
        if (s < 0) s += mod;
        return s;
    }

    static int mult(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % mod);
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> matrixMult(List<List<int[]>> a, List<List<int[]>> b) {
        int size = k + 1;
        List<List<int[]>> c = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            c.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                c.get(i).add(new int[]{0});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int val = 0;
                for (int t = 0; t <= k; t++) {
                    int[] aVal = a.get(i).get(t);
                    int[] bVal = b.get(t).get(j);
                    val = sum(val, mult(aVal[0], bVal[0]));
                }
                c.get(i).set(j, new int[]{val});
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> shiftBy1(List<List<int[]>> mat) {
        int size = k + 1;
        List<List<int[]>> c = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            c.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                c.get(i).add(new int[]{0});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int ni = i;
                if (ni < k) ni = (ni + k - 1) % k;
                int nj = j;
                if (nj < k) nj = (nj + k - 1) % k;
                c.get(i).set(j, new int[]{mat.get(ni).get(nj)[0]});
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static void print(List<List<int[]>> c) {
        for (List<int[]> row : c) {
            for (int[] v : row) {
                System.out.print(v[0] + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
        System.out.println("------------");
    }

    static void init() {
        long digs = 0;
        long cop = n;
        while (cop > 0) {
            cop /= k;
            digs++;
        }
        pref.clear();
        // Initialize pref with size needed
        pref.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            pref.get(0).add(new int[]{0});
        }
        // Set initial pref[0]
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            pref.get(0).set(i, new int[]{1});
        }
        pref.get(0).set(0, new int[]{0});
        pref.get(0).set(k, new int[]{1});
        pref.get(0).set(k, new int[]{2});
        // To maintain consistency, manually set these
        // Now, build pref for each step
        for (int step = 0; step < digs; step++) {
            // copy previous
            List<List<int[]>> newPref = new ArrayList<>();
            for (List<int[]> row : pref.get(0)) {
                newPref.add(new ArrayList<>(row));
            }
            pref.add(newPref);
            List<List<int[]>> cur = pref.get(step);
            for (int i = 1; i <= k - 1; i++) {
                cur = shiftBy1(cur);
                pref.set(step + 1, matrixMult(pref.get(step + 1), cur));
            }
        }
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> solve(long n) {
        List<List<int[]>> c = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            c.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                c.get(i).add(new int[]{0});
            }
        }
        if (n == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                c.get(i).set(i, new int[]{1});
            }
            return c;
        }
        long pw = 1;
        int dig = 0;
        while (pw <= n / k) {
            pw *= k;
            dig++;
        }
        if (n == pw) {
            return pref.get((int)dig);
        }
        long steps = n / pw;
        long left = n - steps * pw;
        List<List<int[]>> curMat = solve(0);
        List<List<int[]>> curCoef = pref.get((int)dig);
        for (long i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            curMat = matrixMult(curMat, curCoef);
            curCoef = shiftBy1(curCoef);
        }
        List<List<int[]>> otherMat = solve(left);
        for (long i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            otherMat = shiftBy1(otherMat);
        }
        return matrixMult(curMat, otherMat);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        init();
        List<List<int[]>> mat = solve(n);
        System.out.println(mat.get(k).get(k)[0]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
